subject: SIG: proof of ephemeral key wipe & operator logs
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <security@greenfieldpay.com>, Will Turner <will@ciphertrust-audit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: proof of ephemeral key wipe & operator logs

Hi Marta / Will,

Thanks for the SIG follow-up this morning. Per Greenfield's checklist we want to deliver the minimal artifacts you requested to demonstrate ephemeral-key handling and the operator-level audit trail for the HSM ceremony. High-level plan below: 

- We will drop a redacted operator shift bundle + HSM wipe manifest to the SFTP path (link below) by EOD PT Wednesday (2025-06-11).
- The wipe manifest will include timestamps, key identifiers (key IDs only), and a SHA256 hash of the manifest itself. Operator identifiers will be redacted and replaced by unique operator pseudonyms (e.g., OP-01) to preserve privacy while preserving traceability.
- For sensitive artifacts that require an NDA, we'll send a DocuSign link for a targeted NDA so we can share full operator IDs and complete audit trails.

Attachments (included in first drop): operator_shift_log_202506.zip (redacted CSV), hsm_wipe_manifest_redacted.pdf, sftp-delivery-manifest.txt.

Confirm if the above meets Greenfield's needs or if you need additional fields in the manifest (e.g., HSM slot serial, firmware build). If so, call out specific columns and we'll include them in the redacted bundle.

SFTP (drop): sftp://s3-uploads.greenfieldpay.com/inbound/2025/06/ben_carter/
HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.com/deal/GP-8932

Thanks — I'll loop Jonas for operator log extraction and Marissa for legal on the NDA.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <security@greenfieldpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: proof of ephemeral key wipe & operator logs

Ben,

Thanks — that plan sounds reasonable. A couple of clarifications before we confirm acceptance: 

1) Wipe window: can you confirm the exact UTC window when the ephemeral key material was zeroized? Greenfield needs a +/- 5 minute timestamp for our timeline.
2) Manifest hash: please include a SHA256 hex string at the top of the PDF so we can independently verify the file after download.
3) Operator mapping: OP-01 style pseudonyms are fine for the initial exchange; we will request full operator-to-pseudonym mapping only after our legal team executes the targeted NDA.
4) HSM metadata: vendor model, HSM serial (partial redaction is fine: show last 4 digits), and firmware version are required for our intake.

If you can add (1) and (2) to the manifest before the drop that would speed our review. We'll stand by on the DocuSign NDA; I can route it internally once we have SFTP credentials and the manifest hash.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Marta Ruiz
Security & Compliance Lead
Greenfield Payments
security@greenfieldpay.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 08:45:10 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: proof of ephemeral key wipe & operator logs

Marta —

Thanks for the clear asks. We completed the extraction and uploaded the redacted package at 2025-06-11T15:12:03Z (UTC). Delivery notes and checksums are in sftp-delivery-manifest.txt (attached). Specifics below so you have them inline too: 

- Wipe window (UTC): 2025-06-11T15:08:47Z — 2025-06-11T15:09:03Z (16 second window).
- Manifest SHA256: 9f2b7c6d1a2e4c3b5f6a8d9e0b1c2d3f4e5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c
- HSM metadata (redacted): Vendor: Thales Luna 7xx, Serial (last 4): ****-4821, Firmware: 4.3.12

We redacted operator names to OP-01 / OP-02. Jonas captured the operator shift logs and produced the CSV with pseudonyms and the shift start/end times. Marissa — legal, can you confirm whether the targeted NDA is sufficient for sharing the operator mapping and the full (unredacted) HSM audit trail? If yes I'll route the DocuSign link to Marta.

Attachments uploaded to SFTP drop: operator_shift_log_202506.zip (redacted), hsm_wipe_manifest_redacted.pdf, sftp-delivery-manifest.txt. I included a small checksum file for the ZIP and the manifest.

If you'd like a short readout call to walk through the files, I can be available 1pm PT today.

Onward —
Ben Carter
Enterprise Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Received the SFTP drop and verified the manifest hash against the file we pulled. Quick notes from the auditor POV: 

- The 16-second zeroize window and the HSM serial (last 4 digits) are sufficient for initial SIG intake.
- We'll need the targeted NDA executed to map OP-01/OP-02 back to identities and to request a vendor-signed HSM attestation for the zeroize action (standard for our internal acceptance).
- Once the NDA is signed, please upload the vendor attestation PDF to the same SFTP folder and send the DocuSign link to will@ciphertrust-audit.com as well.

Happy to join a quick call tomorrow if you want to walk the artifacts with the audit team.
